items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Johnny Delpy was a good man that day too.

ctx.x: Oh, Roussel. I think I'm Roussel. Let me see.

Who, what are some of the good- Johnny Delpy was a good man that day too. What did he play? He's a violin player, a guitar player. But the best guitar player I've ever known, anywhere in the world, was a fellow by the name of Frank DeLandry. Frank DeLandry, goddamn. Now Frank DeLandry was a fellow, if you ask me up until today, now as far as I'm concerned they ain't got no guitars on earth today. Even now all the guitars is buried, when it comes to Frank. Where is he from? Now if somebody asks me, understand that…
